name: SlicerCaches
description: Represents the collection of slicer caches associated with the specified workbook.
remarks: Use the Item property of the SlicerCaches collection to return a SlicerCache object associated with the specified Workbook object. A SlicerCache object can be retrieved by using either the value of the Index property or the Name property of the specified object.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent Workbook object for the collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of objects in the collection.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Returns a single SlicerCache object from the collection.

methods.name: Add2
methods.signature: Add2(Source As Variant, SourceField As Variant, [Name As Variant], [SlicerCacheType As Variant]) As SlicerCache
